assuranceRules: Presence in this manifest does not mean the contract passed.
No D01-D20 Assurance score changes until clean-checkout execution evidence exists.
A provider effect is not exactly-once unless provider or resource reconciliation evidence closes every crash window.
A fencing token must be validated at the resource commit boundary using an explicit evaluation time.
A run cannot complete while a critical step or required acceptance criterion is unresolved.
Isolation decision objects do not replace a trusted pinned transport or handle broker.
No production database, Supabase project, deployment or automatic GitHub Action is used by these static contracts.
